record.cardDesc: Record your actions for Agent reference
record.sectionHint: Generates a recording instruction — send it to your Agent to start recording your actions; the Agent can then use the resulting trace bundle to automate similar tasks.
record.promptTemplate:
Use BrowserSkill's `bsk` CLI to record the browser actions I'm about to demonstrate.

Steps:
1. Run: {{command}}
2. Once you confirm it's started, I'll operate in the opened window myself.
3. After I click Finish, read the written `./trace` bundle (`trace.json` + `states/`) and summarize what I did.

longScreenshot.title: Full-page screenshot
longScreenshot.cardDesc: Capture a whole page, preview and save it
longScreenshot.description: Capture a whole page automatically, or scroll manually to build a clear long image.
longScreenshot.hint: Automatic starts at the top. Manual starts here and also works on browser and store pages.
longScreenshot.cancelled: Capture cancelled. Your scroll position has been restored.
longScreenshot.runningHint: Keep this tab selected. You can close the popup, or pause to interact with the page. Reopen here to resume or finish early.
longScreenshot.previewHint: Saved locally. Preview tiles load as needed; downloading creates the full PNG. Save images you want to keep.
longScreenshot.missingDescription: This preview may have expired or been removed. Return to the webpage and capture it again from Quick actions.
longScreenshot.downloadError: Could not start the download. Please try again.

errors.unsupported: Automatic scrolling is unavailable here. Try manual scrolling or the visible area.
errors.unavailable: The browser did not allow this capture. Click the extension again or check page access permissions.
errors.busy: Another task is using this page, or a capture is already running. Wait for it to finish.
errors.changed: The page changed during capture. Keep the tab, window size and page content stable, then try again.
errors.tooLarge: The browser could not process this image. Try adjusting the capture area.
errors.timeout: This page operation timed out. You can save the completed portion.
errors.captureFailed: Could not complete the screenshot. The page was restored. Please try again.
errors.saveFailed: Local storage is full or unavailable. Free up some space and try again.
errors.interrupted: Capture was interrupted. You can save the completed portion.
errors.storageFull: Local storage is full. Free some space; captured content is still available to preview and export.
errors.alignment: Could not align these frames reliably. Scroll back a little for more overlap, then scroll down slowly.

longScreenshot.manualHint: Manual mode: close this popup and scroll down slowly, keeping overlapping content. Reopen here and choose Finish to save.
longScreenshot.pausedHint: Paused. You can load more content, then resume from the captured position.
longScreenshot.partial: The captured portion has been kept.
